key_audit_matters: Revenue Recognition: The Company recognises revenue from sale of PVC pipes and fittings when control of goods is transferred to the buyer, net of quantity discounts. Identified as key audit matter because revenue is a key performance indicator and its recognition involves judgment in determining the timing of transfer of control at year-end and in estimating quantity discounts payable to dealers.
